## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (`flutter test`)
- [ ] `flutter analyze` and `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .` are clean
- [ ] Public API changes have dartdoc and a README update
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has an entry under "Unreleased" (marked **Breaking** if apps must change code)
- [ ] Native changes were tried on a device (say which)
